items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I think Madame Schumann-Heinck gave an audition, as it was, to Marian Anderson, a colored woman, very fine voice, very fine person.

ctx.x: Yes. And that same day, I think Madame Schumann-Heinck gave an audition, as it was, to Marian Anderson, a colored woman, very fine voice, very fine person. And I used to play numbers like The Rosary and Because and numbers like that on the theremin. I guess old Johnny Hyman would remember that. Johnny, Johnny used to play around with it too, where it was Wuerlines.
